holding_summary: Equity dispute between adjoining landowners over dedication and obstruction of a private alley; injunction against obstruction affirmed.
notes: Property boundary/easement dispute; no letting or lodging issue.

holding_summary: Divorce decree reversed where evidence of wife's desertion was fabricated and record instead showed husband's own desertions.
notes: Mentions husband renting furnished rooms for his wife/daughter as an incidental fact in a desertion case; not litigation over letting practice itself.

holding_summary: Borough lacked statutory authority to license motor vehicles carrying passengers for hire; such power suspended by state Motor Vehicle Act.
notes: Motor carrier licensing case, unrelated to lodging/letting of dwellings.

holding_summary: Divorce decree for desertion reversed on appeal; mere silence of complainant does not establish mutual consent to separation.
notes: Couple's occupancy of rooms in a rooming-house is incidental background to a desertion claim, not an adjudicated lodging/letting issue.

holding_summary: Private garage found to be a nuisance interfering with neighbor's use of her home; removal order (available only to municipality) struck, damages award vacated for insufficient proof.
notes: Garage-as-nuisance/zoning case; no letting of rooms or dwelling for pay.

holding_summary: Commercial store lease's acceleration clause triggered by receivership; landlord entitled to preferred claim for one year's rent under 1919 Act, remainder as general creditor.
notes: Commercial storeroom lease/receivership priority dispute, not residential lodging.

holding_summary: Zoning Board of Appeals erred in permitting enclosure of a porch as a garage absent findings of practical difficulty or unnecessary hardship.
notes: Zoning variance procedure for a garage addition; unrelated to lodging/letting.

holding_summary: Injunction sustained against occupying a garage as a residence in violation of a deed restriction requiring a two-story dwelling costing at least $2,500.
notes: Restrictive-covenant enforcement re: garage-as-residence; no letting for pay at issue.

holding_summary: Summary judgment reversed in dispute over buyer's right to inspect potatoes shipped f.o.b. before accepting/rejecting a produce contract.
notes: Sale-of-goods contract dispute; wholly unrelated to lodging or dwelling occupancy.

holding_summary: Leasing garage space exclusively to an apartment house's own tenants for car storage is a private, not public, garage use, so contempt order for violating injunction against public-garage use reversed.
notes: Public-vs-private garage nuisance/injunction case involving apartment tenants; no bearing on letting rooms/dwellings for pay.

holding_summary: Will construction case; devise of two houses 'to collect the rents...as long as she shall live' held to pass a fee simple, not a life estate.
notes: Testamentary construction/estates case; rent-collection language is about ownership incidents, not lodging practice.

holding_summary: Fire insurance policy upheld for plaintiff where no evidence landlord knew of or controlled tenant's operation of an illegal still that increased fire hazard.
notes: Insurance/landlord-tenant hazard-increase dispute; tenancy is incidental to the insurance question, not about lodging/letting doctrine.

holding_summary: North Carolina juvenile court custody decree entitled to full faith and credit; children ordered returned to North Carolina custody (majority opinion), with a dissent urging a best-interests rehearing.
notes: Child-custody/full-faith-and-credit case; 'boarding house keeper' is merely the custodian's occupation, not a litigated lodging arrangement.

holding_summary: Husband's divorce action for desertion denied; wife's departure from husband's parents' home was legally justified and husband acquiesced in the separation.
notes: Wife's proposal to get furnished rooms is a hypothetical living arrangement mentioned in a desertion case, not an adjudicated letting issue.

holding_summary: Default judgment against landlord for failure to repair set aside because no cause of action was stated; landlord has no duty to repair absent an express lease covenant.
notes: Ordinary landlord repair-duty/negligence pleading case; not about the character or regulation of short-term letting.

holding_summary: Landlord's summary possession judgment for nonpayment of rent reversed on demurrer because the statement of claim omitted facts essential under the 1830 Act.
notes: Procedural pleading dispute over a commercial premises lease ($2,000/year); not lodging/boarding.

holding_summary: Tax assessment case holding that under the 1842 Act a farm split by borough lines is assessed where the mansion house sits, though a separate dwelling in exclusive occupancy of the owner's mother and sister (rent-free) is separately assessable in the borough.
notes: Property tax-assessment/mansion-house doctrine case; family rent-free occupancy is discussed for tax severance purposes, not short-term paid lodging.

holding_summary: Cotenant in sole possession of jointly-owned property owes no accounting to cotenants for use and occupation absent an express agreement, ouster, or rents received from third parties.
notes: Tenants-in-common accounting dispute over inherited property; no third-party lodging/letting involved.
